product_north_star.mission: Bring the modern smartphone back to the Nokia era, when phones were useful tools rather than addictive attention machines, while retaining a refined modern minimalist feeling.
product_north_star.priority: Umbrella constraint for every feature, interaction, UX, and visual design decision.
product_north_star.design_gate: Prefer essential utility, finite deliberate interactions, Nokia-era calm, privacy, and modern polish. Reject attention loops, compulsive-use mechanics, unnecessary motion, and engagement-maximizing patterns.

typography.screen_font: Space Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
typography.keypad_font: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

layout.global: h-[100dvh] w-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-black text-white select-none

top_screen.container: h-[50dvh] w-full p-4 relative flex flex-col bg-black border-b border-white/20
top_screen.inner_display: flex-1 overflow-hidden relative flex flex-col gap-4

bottom_keypad.container: h-[50dvh] w-full p-4 md:p-6 bg-[#050505] flex items-center justify-center
bottom_keypad.grid: grid grid-cols-3 grid-rows-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 h-full w-full max-w-[400px]

screen_list_item.default: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 border-b border-white/10 text-white/70 transition-none
screen_list_item.selected: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-white text-black font-bold transition-none scale-100

keypad_button.base: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-white/10 bg-[#111] shadow-[0_4px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] active:translate-y-[4px] active:shadow-none active:bg-white active:text-black transition-all duration-75
keypad_button.letters: text-[9px] md:text-xs font-bold tracking-widest mt-1 opacity-60

status_bar.container: flex justify-between items-center pb-2 border-b border-white/20 text-xs md:text-sm font-mono opacity-80

icons.usage: Use sharp, un-rounded icons. Battery, Signal, Wifi for status bar. Minimalist stroke icons for apps.

interactions_and_motion.philosophy: Zero-latency physical feel. No slow fades. Hardware responds instantly.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use duration-75 or transition-none. When a key is pressed, it must immediately invert colors.
interactions_and_motion.navigation_logic: T9 acts as D-Pad in menus: 2 (Up), 8 (Down), 4 (Left), 6 (Right), 5 (Select/Action).

app_categorization.important_apps: Render with bold typography, prominent icons, pushed to top of lists. Examples: Maps, WhatsApp, Messages, Phone.
app_categorization.unimportant_apps: Render smaller, lower opacity (text-secondary). Examples: Games, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Construct the UI strictly for mobile proportions locking height to 100dvh. Prevent scrolling on the body.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Top 50% must purely act as the 'screen'. Use a React state manager to track the 'selected_index' of the currently highlighted app or menu item.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement the keypad so it conditionally handles navigation (D-Pad via 2,4,6,8 and Select via 5) when browsing lists, and T9 typing when in an input field.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The active/selected item in the screen menu should use the 'selected' styling (inverted black-on-white) to clearly show cursor position without touch.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use rounded-xl or soft UI. Stay true to the Swiss Brutalist / Retro hardware design: sharp borders, crisp monochrome contrasts.
